name: gamecenter-lounge
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: wide website background, landscape 16:9
Primary request: An original dreamy 3D miniature arcade lounge for a family game hub called Game Center. Warm charcoal/brown background #1d1410 with warm amber #ffbd55 and coral #f46e57 details.
Scene/backdrop: a sculpted miniature arcade lounge suggested around the outer edges, with just a few glowing playful geometric shapes and refined arcade joystick/button details.
Style/medium: premium playful 3D render, soft tactile enamel and rounded shapes, tasteful and inviting.
Composition/framing: Wide landscape. Keep the central 65 percent of the image dark, quiet, spacious and largely empty for a website interface to be layered over it. Decorative arcade objects sit near the corners and outer edges, never dominating the center. Full bleed scene.
Lighting/mood: gentle amber glows, restrained coral highlights, dreamy cinematic ambient light; deep warm dark central negative space.
Constraints: No text, no letters, no people, no logos, no watermark. This is standalone background artwork, not a screenshot or interface mockup.

name: gamecenter-icon
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: square home-screen app icon, 1:1
Primary request: An original bold golden arcade joystick/play emblem with one coral button for a family game hub called Game Center.
Scene/backdrop: Full-bleed warm charcoal/brown #1d1410 square background with subtle amber illumination.
Subject: one centered iconic golden amber #ffbd55 arcade joystick/play emblem, simple sculpted joystick form with a distinct coral #f46e57 button; a compact recognizable silhouette.
Style/medium: premium playful 3D render, clean sculpted enamel, smooth softly rounded forms, polished but tactile.
Composition/framing: Square, centered with a safe margin of approximately 18 percent on all sides. Very clear recognizable form at tiny app-icon sizes. The background fills the entire square, with no baked outer padding and no transparency.
Lighting/mood: warm amber light, restrained coral accent, soft dimensional shadow.
Constraints: No letters, no words, no text, no outside logos, no watermark, no border, no phone mockup. Avoid clutter and fine detail.

name: gamecenter-share
prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: social share artwork, landscape approximately 1.91:1
Primary request: An original premium playful share card for the family game hub Game Center, with elegant amber and coral 3D arcade motifs on a warm dark background.
Scene/backdrop: warm charcoal/brown #1d1410; golden amber #ffbd55 arcade joystick and play-shape details with coral #f46e57 buttons, arranged elegantly around the typography.
Style/medium: tactile sculpted enamel 3D miniature arcade motif, softly rounded forms, warm dimensional lighting, sophisticated playful aesthetic.
Composition/framing: Landscape near 1.91:1 aspect ratio. Large crisp centered title with a clearly readable subtitle underneath. Keep all lettering well inside safe margins. Decorative 3D arcade shapes frame the type without covering it.
Text (verbatim): "GAME CENTER"
Subtitle (verbatim): "Good games. Questionable bragging rights."
Typography: very legible bright cream rounded lettering; title large and bold, subtitle smaller but still clear. The only text in the image must be exactly those two lines, with correct punctuation and spelling.
Lighting/mood: warm amber glow and restrained coral accents, inviting and playful.
Constraints: No outside logos, no watermark, no phone mockup, no interface screenshot.
